offline_risk.fact: flake.lock pins tgw-flake and its transitive inputs, including SSH Git sources, but the evaluation archive does not contain their Nix store closure.
offline_risk.implication: With offline/no-substituters, a correct evaluation-only attribute remains executable only when every locked input is already present in the evaluator store or is admitted as a separately content-addressed input closure.

recommendation.closed_attribute: Expose a dedicated x86_64-linux review-egress-systemd-units derivation/check that imports nix/review-egress.nix into a minimal NixOS evaluation, enables it with exact symbolic non-secret settings, and copies only the three generated unit files plus verifier inputs to its output.
recommendation.evaluator: Evaluate and build only that exact attribute, not nixosConfigurations.tgw-prod or a full system closure; continue systemd-analyze verification and exact unit hashes over its output.
recommendation.input_closure: Before execution, prove every flake.lock input is locally available by exact store/NAR identity, or extend the typed request with a bounded content-addressed input-closure artifact and verify/import it without substituters. Never fall back to network or the live flake checkout.
recommendation.tests: Add a real flake-output test proving the exact attribute exists, imports the module, contains exactly the admitted unit set, and fails when any locked input is unavailable under offline flags.

root_cause.flake_output: The frozen flake exports only devShells = tgw-flake.devShells.
root_cause.missing_integration: nix/review-egress.nix is not imported by the frozen flake or any exported configuration.
